column1: # SecurePrompt — test quarantine manifest (WS6-1).
# EVERY `#[ignore]`d Rust test in the workspace MUST have a row here. The test
# gate (`scripts/ci/rust-test-gate.sh`) counts the `N ignored` figure cargo
# prints for each suite and compares it against the rows below. If they differ
# the gate FAILS. That is the mechanism that makes silent exclusion impossible:
# you cannot skip a test without also declaring it here, in the diff, in review.
# To un-quarantine: delete the `#[ignore = "..."]` attribute in the test file
# AND delete the row here. Both, or the gate fails.
# Columns: cargo-selector <TAB> test-name <TAB> class <TAB> reason
# class = QUARANTINE  → a genuinely failing test, deliberately not gating.
#                       Must name a root cause and a follow-up.
# class = ENVIRONMENT → passes, but needs infrastructure CI does not provide.
# QUARANTINE — 6 failures across 4 suites. Baseline recorded at origin/main
# bea4cb2 (plan 2026-07-27-prd-workstreams.md, Global Constraint 9) and
# re-verified at fix/ws1-security-cluster before quarantining.
# ROOT CAUSE (all 6): these suites drive the router with `tower::ServiceExt::
# oneshot`, which does not install the `ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>` request
# extension that `secureprompt-api/src/http/routes/openai.rs` extracts at
# lines 82 / 214 / 316. The extractor rejects, the handler never runs, and the
# route answers 500 instead of 200. It is a TEST-HARNESS defect, not a product
# defect: production installs ConnectInfo via
# `into_make_service_with_connect_info` (see main.rs:413), and
# `tests/sidecar_failure_policy.rs:253` proves the same routes return 200 once
# the extension is inserted by hand — that suite passes, 33/33.
# SECOND CAUSE (openai_compat only): its three tests additionally assert the
# response body contains the literal "openai echo" (openai_compat.rs:48,88).
# That string came from a stub adapter that has since been replaced by a real
# HTTP adapter, so the assertion is stale even once ConnectInfo is fixed.
# FOLLOW-UP: WS6-1-FU1 — port the `ConnectInfo` insertion from
# tests/sidecar_failure_policy.rs:244-253 into tests/support/mod.rs so every
# suite gets it, then replace the "openai echo" assertions with a mock HTTP
# provider. Tracked in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-27-prd-workstreams.md.
-p secureprompt-api --test openai_compat
